name: @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent
description: Coding agent CLI with read, bash, edit, write tools and session management

scripts.build:unbundled: node ../../scripts/build-native-process.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs executable dist/cli.js dist/rpc-entry.js && bun run copy-assets
scripts.build:binary: (cd ../tui && bun run build) && (cd ../telemetry && bun run build) && (cd ../ai && bun run build) && (cd ../agent && bun run build) && bun run build && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-bunfig --no-compile-autoload-dotenv ./dist/bun/cli.js ./src/utils/image-resize-worker.ts ./src/extensions/codemode/worker.ts --outfile dist/axiom && bun run copy-binary-assets
scripts.copy-assets: node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json" dist/modes/interactive/theme && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/modes/interactive/assets/*.png" dist/modes/interactive/assets && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy src/core/export-html/template.html src/core/export-html/template.css src/core/export-html/template.js dist/core/export-html && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js" dist/core/export-html/vendor
scripts.copy-binary-assets: node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy package.json README.md CHANGELOG.md docs examples ../../node_modules/@silvia-odwyer/photon-node/photon_rs_bg.wasm dist && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy native/process dist/native && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json" dist/theme && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/modes/interactive/assets/*.png" dist/assets && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy src/core/export-html/template.html dist/export-html && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy "src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js" dist/export-html/vendor
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build

author: Mario Zechner
